definition: The currency the merchant gets paid out to their bank account.
Comprised of the currency and amount, the transactional currency is what BigCommerce passes to the payment provider and what is charged to a shopper's bank account.
The "Authorize only" feature allows your payment gateway to authorize the charge without actually withdrawing the funds from the customer's account until you approve it.
Offline payment methods are ways to pay for orders that do not require a credit card or a traditional payment gateway.
For stores on self-serve plans, orders processed using offline payment methods and payment providers that are not on our Embedded Payment Provider list are assessed an Open Payment Provider fee.

PayPal Commerce Platform, also known as PayPal Complete Payments (PPCP), is another name for PayPal's dedicated payment gateway, used to distinguish it from other PayPal solutions supported by BigCommerce. In most instances, it is simply referred to as PayPal.

Hosted payment gateways navigate shoppers away from your checkout to the payment service provider’s page. After entering their payment details and completing the transaction, they are redirected back to your storefront.
